description: Create timing pipeline stage and studio/timing.py helper to synchronize animation timing with voiceover duration. Add duration validation in export stage.
steps: Create pipeline/stages/timing.py: runs after voice, uses faster-whisper with word_timestamps=True to extract per-segment timing, matches segments to script scenes using # Scene headers, outputs timing.yaml
Create studio/timing.py: helper module with load_timing() and data classes for scenes to consume timing information
Update pipeline/stages/__init__.py to add timing stage after voice and before subtitles/render
Update pipeline/stages/export.py to add duration validation (video duration vs voice duration, warn if >2s difference)
Add tests for timing stage and studio/timing.py
Run ruff check . && ruff format --check . && pytest tests/ -v
acceptance_criteria: studio/timing.py exists with load_timing() and get_scene_duration() functions
timing stage is registered after voice in STAGES list
export stage validates video vs voice duration
pytest tests/ -v passes all tests (60 existing + new)
